integrity: The all-alphabet theorem is supported by an explicit Euler-tour normalization, a directed matrix-tree calculation and an evaluated Schur complement. Exact integer determinant and independent exhaustive finite tests reproduce the stated small cases. Historical priority is qualified and independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns length-three repeated-symbol words over a fixed labeled alphabet of size at least two, identified under rotation alone. It does not cover longer windows, reversal, or symbol-relabeling quotients. Finite checks through alphabet size six corroborate but do not establish the all-alphabet theorem.
title: Exact enumeration of universal cycles of noninjective three-letter words
